_doc: Co-speech motion and safety settings for Zang. Angles in degrees here (human-edited); code converts to radians. Everything marked placeholder must be re-measured on the robot.

cospeech_envelope_deg._doc: Range the co-speech planner may use, in ANATOMICAL degrees (arm: pitch + = forward/up, roll + = outward, elbow + = flexed toward the midline; gaze + = turn to robot's left). Tighter than the joint limits on purpose.

gaze._doc: Zang has no head: gaze turns the waist. Zing head-pan degrees are multiplied by gain.

sway._doc: Weight shift: hip_roll and ankle_roll counter-rotate (feet stay flat). deg at sway = 1.

leg_cospeech._doc: Leg joints during co-speech: small, slow (feet planted).

collision._doc: Arm geoms must stay clearance_mm from every other body (MuJoCo collision meshes). Projection aims for clearance + headroom so servo lag/overshoot (seen in the physics twin) cannot reach the body.

balance._doc: Static CoM must project inside the feet polygon by this margin, else the motion is shrunk toward home.

servo_model._doc: PLACEHOLDER (DS-R003G not identified yet). Used by the physics twin on top of the MJCF position actuators: command latency, internal speed limit of the servo.
